buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1.1. Online electronic bid (e-tender) at GeM portal is invited through Local competitive bidding reserved fo r Project Affected Families (PAF) under “Two Packet Bid system” for and on behalf of NHPC Limited (A Government of India Navratna Enterprise) from eligible sole bidder for the work of “Hiring of (25+D)/ 26 Seater Non-AC vehicle (traveler or equivalent make) for two years at Parbati-III Power Station”. 1.2. (A) Instant bid type is “Two Packet Bid”, so bidder/seller is advised to upload/quote financial offer in i ts financial bid only as where applicable at GeM Portal. (B) Utmost care shall be taken by bidder/seller while uploading technical bid documents at GeM Port al that it should not contain “Financial offer/Price bid” in any form. The bidder/seller are caution ed that uploading financial offer or disclosing/revealing its quoted price in any form in its techni cal bid document will result in rejection of tender. (C) Instant bid is for “Hiring of (25+D)/26 Seater Non-AC Vehicle- Without Fuel”. Bidder has to quote “Total Contract Price inclusive of applicable GST” against our estimated amount i.e. Rs. 12,46,9 72/- (Hiring Charge without Fuel for 02 Years). 1.3. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA FOR BIDDER: (A) Project Affected Families (PAFs) in the form of Individuals, partnership firms, group of people in t he form of Cooperative societies/ Self Help Groups (SHGs)/ Companies (having 100% beneficiaries from the category of PAFs) will only be considered. (B) The eligibility of PAF to participate in the tenders shall be considered taking into account the wo rks/services awarded to PAF’s family as a whole. The person, his family along with legal heirs s hall be considered as single PAF. (C) To qualify for contract for which bids are invited, bidder must submit following documents with their Bid: · Proof of PAFs issued from the office of Land Acquisition officer.

· Copy of Parivar Nakal (originating from PAF identity) issued from the competent autho rity in case of bidder participating as a PAF’s Family /legal heirs. (D) The value of works and services to be awarded to any single entity (i.e. PAF’s family as a whole ) at any point of time shall be limited to Rs. 125 Lac (Rupees One Hundred Twenty Five Lac onl y) and at a time* not more than 04 nos. of works/services shall be allotted / awarded to any si ngle entity (i.e. PAF’s family as a whole) (*) The term ‘at a time’ shall mean that 04 nos. of works / services have been awarded & are s till under execution (i.e. not completed) to/by one PAF entity. (E) Bids of those Bidders who have not submitted the EMD as sought under “EMD Details of Bid Do cument” shall not be considered for evaluation, except in case of exemption. The bidder seeki ng EMD exemption, must submit the valid supporting document for the relevant category as p er GeM GTC with the bid. Under MSE category, only Service Providers for Services are eligible f or exemption from EMD. Traders are excluded from the purview of this Policy. (F) All bidders meeting Qualification criteria as defined in clause 1.5 1.4. QUALIFICATION CRITERIA Bidder must be an owner of requisite vehicle i.e. (25+D)/26 Seater Non-AC vehicle (traveler or equiv alent make). Self Declaration in this regard is to be submitted as per proforma provided at Annexure-X. OR i) Undertaking is to be submitted on non- judicial Stamp paper of appropriate value as per pr oforma provided at Annexure-XI AND ii) Proof of financial capacity in the form of Saving Bank account / Current Bank account / NSC/ KVP/ Bankers Certificate or any other valid instrument for the Value of INR 15.0 Lakhs (either individually or combining together) duly issued/endorsed by the Bank/financial Institution. (up to date amount on last date of previous month of published tender shall be considered for qu alification) OR Comfort letter issued from any Bank / financial institution that the bidder would be sanctioned a loan (mentioning the loan amount) for purchase of new vehicle. If the sanction loan capacity amount is less than INR 15.00 Lakhs, bidder may submit financial capacity proof for balance a mount, in any one or combined instruments mentioned above. 1.5. Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid. i) Copy of PAN Card ii) Copy of GSTIN /Certificate of CA, in case of unregistered bidder.

iii) Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank iv) Declaration of Ineligibility: Annexure-III v) Undertaking by bidder towards Anti-Profiteering Clause: Annexure-V vi) Self Certificate for Local Content: Annexure-VI vii) Declaration for insolvency proceedings under IBC 2016: Annexure – VII viii) SA Code of Services : Annexure-VIII ix) Undertaking : Annexure-IX x) Declaration regarding possession of Vehicle (Annexure-X), as applicable xi) Undertaking regarding deployment of vehicle (Annexure-XI) , as applicable 1.6. Bidders are advised to check applicable GST on their own before quoting. Buyer will not take any resp onsibility in this regards. GST reimbursement will be as per actual or as per applicable rates (whichever is l ower) subject to the maximum of quoted GST%. 1.7. Contractor shall ensure that the Invoice is raised in the name of Consignee with GSTIN of Consignee o nly. . 2. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of NHPC LIMITED payable at BHUNTAR . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 3. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Banker’s Cheque in favour of NHPC LIMITED payable at BHUNTAR . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the BC along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 4. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Payment online through RTGS / internet banking in Beneficiary name NHPC LIMITED Account No. 11038719758 IFSC Code SBIN0003633 Bank Name STATE BANK OF INDIA Branch address BHUNTAR . Bidder to indicate bid number and name of bidding entity in the transaction details field at the time of on- line transfer. Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the Online Payment Transfer along with bid.
